name: plan-band
description: Shows above the prompt what is left of the plan limits (5-hour and weekly), the context use, the prompt cache and the session cost.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band: auto, en, es, fr, de, pt or it. 'auto' (or any other value) follows the Claude Code 'language' setting, and English when it is not set or not supported.

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lasts after a response: 1h or 5m. The band counts down to its expiry from this value.

showLimits.title: Show limits
showLimits.description: Show the plan limits (5h, 7d...) in the band.

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Show the session cost in the band.

showCtx.title: Show context
showCtx.description: Show the context use (ctx) in the band.

showCache.title: Show cache
showCache.description: Show the prompt cache in the band.
